outcome.answer: DMI-Lib is designed to inspect model internals during inference while minimizing disruption: it moves activation capture off the inference hot path using an asynchronous GPU–CPU observability system, preserving serving optimizations and supporting varied internal signals and inference backends [7]. It reports 0.4%–6.8% overhead in offline batch inference and an average of 6% in moderate online serving, with 2x–15x lower latency overhead than comparable baselines [7].
